2.198.20
RadialScale.Style
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialScale.Style element specifies style properties for a RadialScale. This element is optional.
This element is of type Style.
The following is the parent element of the RadialScale.Style element.
Parent elements
RadialScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialScale.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
